preconditions: PROGRAM identifies an eight-character local definition; ATTRIBUTES is required even at ATTRLEN zero. ATTRLEN is halfword binary in 0..32767; it is optional in the pinned SVG syntax (parser line 16). Exact omitted-length language rules require the general ATTRIBUTES topic.
ATTRIBUTES is one character string using the grammar at lines 17-22. Its attribute keywords are not top-level EXEC operands. COBOL uses ATTRIBUTES(data-area), still sending the string (lines 29-32).

Attribute vocabulary/widths (lines 18-22): DESCRIPTION char58; API CICSAPI/OPENAPI; CEDF YES/NO; DATALOCATION ANY/BELOW; DYNAMIC NO/YES; EXECUTIONSET FULLAPI/DPLSUBSET; JVM NO/YES; REMOTESYSTEM char4; REMOTENAME char8; STATUS ENABLED/DISABLED; TRANSID char4. Non-Java: LANGUAGE ASSEMBLER/C/COBOL/LE370/PLI; CONCURRENCY QUASIRENT/THREADSAFE/REQUIRED; EXECKEY USER/CICS; RELOAD, RESIDENT and USELPACOPY NO/YES; USAGE NORMAL/TRANSIENT. Java: CONCURRENCY THREADSAFE/REQUIRED; EXECKEY USER/CICS; JVMPROFILE char8; JVMSERVER char8; JVMCLASS char255. This is a bounded string subgrammar for the existing compiler, not independently dispatchable attributes.

New public name shares the PROGRAM/MAPSET/PARTITIONSET namespace; a same-name public definition is replaced. Bundle-installed PROGRAM cannot be replaced (lines 37-45). Application-private definitions are a separate visibility scope (lines 46-49).
Reject DPLSUBSET and remote DPL without SYNCONRETURN with INVREQ/200 (lines 98-101); reject an incomplete previous CONNECTION/TERMINAL pool with ILLOGIC/2.

ATTRLEN zero requests resource attribute defaults without reading the supplied ATTRIBUTES value (lines 66-69). Default individual attribute values are not inferred from the flattened syntax.
LOG is the default branch in the pinned SVG at line 16; LOGMESSAGE(LOG)/LOG logs resource attributes to CSDL; NOLOG suppresses that attribute log (lines 74-79).

Implicit syncpoint commits preceding recoverable changes on successful CREATE and rolls them back on unsuccessful CREATE, except for exceptions detected early in processing (lines 50-55). Failure of the definition itself must not be treated as generic success.
recovery_obligations: Test prior recoverable UOW commit on successful CREATE and rollback on a late CREATE failure; distinguish the early-exception no-syncpoint boundary (lines 50-55). This does not establish rollback of an already successful installed definition.

lifecycle.resource_authority: Existing mainframe-env-cics installed PROGRAM/MAPSET/PARTITIONSET and public/private application resource authority; shared host program/package and CICS state owners, never a separate administrative database.
preconditions: Single-resource inquiry requires PROGRAM naming an installed module, up to eight characters (lines 486-488); PROGRAM is not unconditional grammar.required because START/END browse forms differ. Browse syntax beyond the names START/AT/NEXT/END remains unresolved pending general browse authority.

For public issuer, resolve only the public PROGRAM. With application context, resolve its private PROGRAM first then fall back to the public PROGRAM; absence returns PGMIDERR (lines 86-97). Do not expose another application version private resource.

APPLICATION, APPLMAJORVER, APPLMINORVER, APPLMICROVER and PLATFORM are START inputs for an explicit full application context, and inquiry outputs for entry-point identity (lines 143-172, 481-485). Exact all-or-none browse context groups require general browse authority.

Program-only options follow their source applicability: APIST, CEDFSTATUS, COBOLTYPE, DATALOCATION, DYNAMSTATUS, EXECKEY, EXECUTIONSET, LANGDEDUCED, LANGUAGE, REMOTENAME, REMOTESYSTEM, RESIDENCY, TRANSID. Java-only JVMCLASS/JVMPROFILE/JVMSERVER report definition fields; sentinel values elsewhere must not be promoted to blanket command-context exclusions.
Command is threadsafe (lines 25-26). Browse is per resource type and rejects repeated START or NEXT/END without an active browse (lines 599-604).
mutations: Return requested fields from installed definition and available current loaded copy; loaded-module information takes precedence on conflict. Never load or autoinstall for inquiry (lines 35-43).
After NEWCOPY/PHASEIN but before subsequent reload, ENTRYPOINT/LENGTH/LIBRARY/LIBRARYDSN/LOADPOINT can describe the old copy. Publish new-copy values only after reload completes (lines 44-56).

Browse state changes on START/NEXT/END, and definitions are returned in alphabetic order with AT selecting a starting point (lines 57-64). This is cursor state, not an administrative resource mutation.

USECOUNT saturates at 2147483647 and counts since current CICS session start; RESCOUNT reports separate contemporaneous uses, not historical uses (lines 518-523, 582-588). Inquiry itself is not a program use/load.
recovery_obligations: A NEXT PGMIDERR/1 caused by a cataloging error requires discard and reinstall of the unusable definition (lines 613-619), respecting discard preconditions rather than mutating automatically.
Concurrent inquiry during refresh must preserve the documented old-copy window and use counts; threadsafe does not supply an internal lock order (lines 25-26, 44-56, 518-523).
